title: Nea Wɔapaw no sɛ Obedi N’ade
intro: Onipa bi a ofi mfe a atwam no mu gyina hɔ a wasiesie ne ho sɛ obetu anammɔn akɔ abakɔsɛm mu. Bere a na ɛte sɛ nea ɔkwan no mu nna hɔ na adwenem naayɛ trɛwee wɔ nkurɔfo no mu no, wɔpaw saa akoa yi sɛ ɔnkɔfa akwankyerɛ atade no. Bere a asɛmpatrɛw kronkron bi mu duru da wɔn mmati so no, wɔkɔɔ wɔn anim sɛ wɔrekɔdi anim wɔ baabi a afoforo twentwɛn wɔn nan ase sɛ wobedi akyi.
clues: Wɔpaw me sɛ menka odiyifo bi ho na misuaa biribi fii wɔn nyansa mu
Migyinaa Adaka no anim bere a yɛn Sustainer no bɔhyɛ bɛn no, na mihuu sɛ nkurɔfo no afi ase regye akyinnye
Wɔmaa megyinaa dee wɔhyɛɛ bɔ no ano bere a yɛn kannifoɔ no dii awerɛhoɔ na ɔsrɛɛ Allah maa yɛn
Wɔpaw me sɛ mentoa asɛmpatrɛw adwuma bi a wɔde ama obi foforo a odii m’anim no so
Wɔmaa me tumi a efi soro sɛ minni nkurɔfo no anim nkɔ baabi a wɔrekɔ
Mitumi wiee nea wofii ase wɔ m’anim no, na minyaa nkurɔfo no si so dua wɔ m’akwankyerɛ ho

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Pow a wɔpow sɛ wɔbɛhyɛn Asase Kronkron a wɔahyɛ ho bɔ no so
Farao asraafo a wɔredi yɛn akyi afa po no mu
Akyinnyegye bere a woate Torah ahyɛde no
trial.answer: Pow a wɔpow sɛ wɔbɛhyɛn Asase Kronkron a wɔahyɛ ho bɔ no so

location.label: Ade Titiriw
options: Torah nhoma mmobɔwee a wɔde maa Musa no
Apam Adaka no wɔ ɔko mu
location.answer: Torah nhoma mmobɔwee a wɔde maa Musa no

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Asase Kronkron a wɔahyɛ ho bɔ no so a wɔbɛkɔ
Ɔfasu a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afi ntuafo ho a wɔbɛkyekye
Nsu a wɔmenee de dii wɔn a wɔpoo nokware no akyi
Nnipa a wɔporɔw ahoni a wɔrebubu
outcome.answer: Asase Kronkron a wɔahyɛ ho bɔ no so a wɔbɛkɔ

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
